data.name: Delta
data.description:
Delta was a Velociraptor that was trained along with the rest of her pack by Owen Grady. She is known for being responsible for the death of Vic Hoskins. She's the second oldest of the four raptors.

Physical Appearance

In the film Jurassic World, Delta is a teal color, with no stripes on her back or tail. Charlie looked similar to Delta, except Charlie was a darker green with black stripes. Like with all the raptors seen on screen, Delta has a unique head from the other raptors by having extra nodules toward the front of the nose and past the eye ridges, making her remarkably similar to the raptors from Jurassic Park III.  Delta is extremely aggressive and displays characteristics of the Jurassic Park raptors. She is arguably the most dangerous velociraptor InGen ever cloned as she is larger than the Jurassic Park raptors, and more intelligent and just as aggressive.  As a baby, she was a darker teal color with a tan lower jaw, and underbelly. She also wore a yellow bracelet around her wrist.  She, like her sisters, has a Cloaca.  Although Delta has the tightest and shallowest Cloaca of the four at only about 1.5-2.5 inches deep.

History

Creation

Delta was the second Velociraptor to be created by InGen for the IBRIS Project. She was created using more avian DNA, resulting in more birdlike movements and actions.  She belonged to a pack consisting of Blue, Charlie, and Echo. She and her pack were trained by Owen Grady, who imprinted on them in their birth.  It is assumed Delta was the second in command of the pack because of her age.  Delta also has a bit of a domination streak in her, and she, like her sisters, is likely extremely horny due to no male dinosaurs being in the park, However, she would also be harder to convince to breed than Blue due to her trauma from the I Rex nearly getting her burned alive.

Jurassic World Containment Breach

Delta and her packmates assisted their trainer in stopping the genetic hybrid Indominus rex's rampage. After her and her packmates met the Indominus rex, Delta and the rest of the raptors turned against Owen and the others. While Claire was driving the truck, Delta and Echo were chasing behind it trying to kill Claire and the boys. Delta came from behind the vehicle and pounced on a wounded InGen Soldier and killed him. She later pursued the humans with Echo as they tried to escape in the vehicle. She tried attacking Gray and Zach Mitchell, who were in the back of the vehicle, but they were able to stun her with an electric prod.

They soon gave up and after hearing Indominus's roar, they ran off the road and into the trees. Some time later, Delta suddenly appeared unexpectedly before Owen, Claire, and the boys. They are forced to flee after the raptor killed Hoskins, who failed at trying to calm her down by copying Owen's hand gesture. After killing Hoskins, Delta continued her pursuit of Owen, Claire and the boys before being distracted by a hologram of a Dilophosaurus that was activated by Gray, but continued her pursuit after realizing it wasn't real. She was eventually met up with Blue and Echo, who had Owen, Claire, Gray, and Zach surrounded. The Indominus rex soon showed up and ordered Blue and the other raptors to attack the humans. Blue hesitates, and turns against the Indominus. The hybrid swatted Blue into a wall, knocking her out. Delta and Echo team up and fight the Indominus to avenge their fallen leader.  Delta was thrown into a grill restaurant located in the park and narrowly avoided being incinerated alive due to some debris taking the brunt of the force and being knocked into the burners in her place.  She and Echo were nearly overpowered before Blue managed to save them.
Like Blue, Delta learned an important lesson on trusting creatures that can speak the Velociraptor language.

Five years later, when Isla Nublar was in danger of being destroyed by Mount Sibo, Delta and her sisters would meet an individual they had not seen in a long time, a feral white lion named Greenstar, who had helped train them after birth, and had been the one to have Owen chosen as the trainer.
Delta and her sisters would be rescued by Greenstar in a race against time and against InGen due to Mount Sibo’s impending eruption despite Greenstar being banned from returning to the island due to controversy surrounding his assistance in funding the Raptors and park Monorail. Delta and her sisters would be relocated much to their anger until they would learn that Greenstar did it to save them from an InGen trap. InGen is still currently after Delta and her sisters at the time of the roleplay.
In the post relocation, Delta and her sisters seem interested in gaining a new island home to live on. Currently her and her pack are hiding on Board the RMS Queen Elizabeth II, a former Cunard OceanLiner now owned by Klaus, who is Greenstar’s  Adopted Father. She and her sisters were relocated due to the volcano threatening to explode, and barely got rescued before it did, destroying their original home.
Like her sisters, Blue, Charlie, and Echo, Delta was created by InGen who had received funding help from General Greenstar, for the IBRIS Project sometime before 2015 as the third raptor of the project.

Side notes

Delta is loyal to Owen and is the most paranoid raptor in the quartet.  Most of the time, she is very contentious, yet mellow. This quiet nature isn't to be mistaken for gentleness, or a lack of wits, as Delta is just as dangerous as her ilk, and has her limits
